newsitem.title: USA: Rally in technology stocks pushes Nasdaq higher.
newsitem.headline: Rally in technology stocks pushes Nasdaq higher.

text.p: A broad rally in technology stocks, fueled by bargain hunters seeking to cash in on low stock prices, pushed Nasdaq shares higher Wednesday, traders said.

Technology stocks have been battered in recent weeks, pushing the Nasdaq composite index down about 10 percent from its January 22 high. Wednesday's rally added 21 points or 1.68 percent to an unofficial close of 1269. Advancing issues beat declining issues 2184 to 1991 on total volume of almost 600 million shares.
"Techs have jumped the past few days. There's been a lot of bargain hunting as investors take advantage of the bad times," one trader said.

Gains in large capitalization technology stocks fueled the increase, with Cisco Systems Inc adding 4-1/2 to 52-3/8, Intel Corp jumping 7-3/8 to 140-5/8 and Microsoft Corp increasing 3-15/16 to 94-1/4. Dell Computer Corp also added 3-15/16 to 71-7/16.

Investor confidence was bolstered, in part, by a Salomon Brothers report suggesting that the technology sector remains healthy despite its recent volatility, traders said. Salomon Brothers recommended buying technology stocks on the current weakness, focusing on companies with dominant marketshare.
